title: Government funds & a city retirement plan — City of Millbrook
instructions: The City of Millbrook is assembling its annual comprehensive financial report. Classify its activities and fund balances, then compute the change in net assets for the defined contribution plan it sponsors for employees (the plan issues separate GAAP financial statements under FASB ASC 962).

exhibits.title: City activities
exhibits.content:
- **A.** Municipal golf course financed by greens fees charged to the public.
- **B.** Central garage that repairs vehicles for police, fire, and parks and bills each department at cost.
- **C.** Gasoline tax revenue legally restricted by state law to road maintenance.
- **D.** Accumulating resources to pay principal and interest on general obligation bonds.
- **E.** Taxes collected on behalf of the county school district and remitted monthly.

exhibits.title: General fund balance items
exhibits.content:
- Supplies inventory **$25,000**.
- **$400,000** set aside by city council ordinance for a future fire station.
- **$150,000** of a federal grant that may be used only for public health.
- **$90,000** the finance director (delegated authority) intends to use for software upgrades.

exhibits.title: Employee 401(k)-type plan data
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Net assets, beginning | 6,400,000 |
| Participant contributions | 780,000 |
| City contributions (incl. $30,000 receivable at year-end) | 390,000 |
| Dividends and interest | 150,000 |
| Net appreciation in fair value | 520,000 |
| Benefits paid | 610,000 |
| Administrative expenses | 25,000 |

parts.prompt: Select the fund type for each activity.

rows.label: A — Golf course
rows.explanation: Fees charged to external users → enterprise (proprietary).

rows.label: B — Central garage
rows.explanation: Services to other departments on a cost-reimbursement basis.

rows.label: C — Gasoline tax for roads
rows.explanation: Proceeds of a specific revenue source restricted to a purpose other than debt service or capital projects.

rows.label: D — Paying general obligation debt
rows.explanation: Accumulates resources for general long-term debt principal and interest.

rows.label: E — School district taxes
rows.explanation: Resources held for another government, not in a trust → custodial (fiduciary).

parts.prompt: Classify each general fund balance item (GASB 54).

rows.label: Council ordinance for fire station $400,000
rows.explanation: Formal action by the highest decision-making authority.

rows.label: Finance director's intended software upgrade $90,000
rows.explanation: Intended use set by an official with delegated authority.

parts.prompt: Compute for the employee plan's Year 2 statements.

rows.label: Total additions
rows.explanation: 780,000 + 390,000 + 150,000 + 520,000 = **1,840,000** (the $30,000 receivable is already included, on the accrual basis).

rows.label: Net assets available for benefits, end of year
